title: 9 February 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles gave their 83rd lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club on this day. It was also the 20th occasion on which they performed both lunchtime and evening shows at the venue.

The group’s lunchtime shows typically lasted from 12-2pm. This was their 132nd known performance overall at the soon-to-be-famous cellar venue on Mathew Street in Liverpool’s city centre, including evening appearances.

Although the precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2013: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Vector Arena, Auckland
  • 2012: Paul McCartney’s star unveiled on Hollywood Walk of Fame
  • 1993: US album release: Off The Ground by Paul McCartney
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Worcester Centrum, Worcester
  • 1979: Mixing: Goodnight Tonight by Wings
  • 1972: Wings live: Nottingham University
  • 1970: Recording: Whispering Grass (Don’t Tell The Trees), Have I Told You Lately That I Love You by Ringo Starr
  • 1967: Recording: Fixing A Hole
  • 1964: The Beatles’ first Ed Sullivan Show
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Empire Theatre, Sunderland
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Technical College Hall, Birkenhead
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: their first Cavern Club show
